description: This file defines the Salary Data Transfer Object (DTO) class, which is used within the OrangeHRM system to retrieve, normalize, and represent salary-related data for employee records. It leverages traits and inheritance to interact with the Employee Salary Service and provides a mapping for data extraction.

classes.name: Salary
classes.description: Data Transfer Object for salary information, including methods to retrieve and normalize salary data based on employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Salary DTO with an optional employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Retrieves salary data filtered by employee number and normalizes it into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping between field names and getter methods for extracting specific salary data attributes.
